sources.title: Qwen3.8-Flash-Next - GitHub
sources.snippet: Qwen3.8-Flash-Next features a 125B-parameter main model, supplemented by an additional 51BN-gram embeddings, with 6Bparameters activated per token. Compared with Qwen3.7-Plus, Qwen3.8-Flash-Next substantially reduces both training and inference cost — training takes only about 1/9 as much, yet it delivers superior capabilities in coding and office tasks.
